Thanks Marta — 14:00 PT on Thu 2025-06-05 is confirmed. I’ve booked a 45-minute slot and sent a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Quick answers to your prep questions:
- SOC 2: a redactable PDF of the SOC 2 report is ideal. If you can’t share that ahead of time, an index of control mappings and where corresponding artifacts live is enough for the intake. We may request redacted copies later for spot checks.
- Log samples: start with a 24-hour sample focused on an activity-rich window (e.g., deploy + traffic spike) — we’ll flag any follow-ups, but that usually surfaces retention and telemetry coverage. If we need a longer window we’ll ask during the call.

Preferred intake: we’ll accept a time-limited S3 upload or a secure SharePoint/Box link. Please avoid sending copies over unencrypted email. If you want, we can spin up a pre-provisioned S3 bucket with a one-time upload token — Ben (cc’d) can coordinate that.

Pre-call asks (so we can use the 45 minutes effectively):
- You: SOC 2 (redacted) OR a control->artifact index; network diagram; sample logs (24h)
- Tom: infra/account list and the name of the KMS owner (if streaming keys are used)
- Us: we’ll pre-populate the CAIQ with clarifying questions and send a highlighted view so you can focus on ambiguous answers

Attachments referenced: CAIQ_Lakeshore_v1.xlsx, evidence_matrix_template.csv (both attached to this thread).

See you Thu at 14:00 PT — calendar invite coming from my account.

Best,
Camila
